title: Physics-Informed Graph-Neural Decoding of the Surface Code: the Logical Signal as an Exact Topological Pairing
summary: We develop a physics-informed graph neural network (GNN) decoder for the surface code that solves a discrete Poisson equation on the syndrome graph, with the syndrome as the charge source. We compare four readout architectures for extracting the logical-error probability: a potential-based readout that maps the Poisson field through a multilayer perceptron, two current-based readouts under single- and two-sink Dirichlet boundary conditions, and a diffusion-based variant.
